signals.title: Identity recovery backlog blocks Bank of E account restoration
signals.businessImpact: Customer access restoration is delayed and support volume remains elevated.
signals.nextAction: Separate lockout volume from suspected abuse and assign decision owner.

signals.title: E Coin fraud signal quality is inconsistent
signals.businessImpact: False positives may slow customer recovery while true fraud remains difficult to prioritize.
signals.nextAction: Add evidence confidence and finance review before executive escalation.

signals.title: External agency asks for decision timeline
signals.businessImpact: Leadership needs a defensible timeline of evidence and decisions.
signals.nextAction: Link every executive recommendation to reviewed source evidence.

signals.title: Healthcare portal readiness is blocked by access review
signals.businessImpact: Patient-facing operations may be delayed unless access review is resolved.
signals.nextAction: Escalate owner and identify decision needed for residual risk acceptance.

signals.title: Employee payroll phishing confusion
signals.businessImpact: Employees may trust incorrect payroll or benefits messages during recovery.
signals.nextAction: Draft HR/legal reviewed employee guidance outside the prototype.

signals.title: Recovery site building access queue delays operations
signals.businessImpact: Recovery teams cannot rotate staff efficiently across sites.
signals.nextAction: Assign operations owner and track whether the issue affects patient or banking operations.

signals.title: Shipping delays are being over-classified as cyber incidents
signals.businessImpact: Incident queues are noisy and executives may misread operational delays as active threats.
signals.nextAction: Separate recovery issue category from threat category.

signals.title: Unverified adversarial chatter references recovery systems
signals.businessImpact: Leadership needs awareness without treating unverified chatter as confirmed activity.
signals.nextAction: Keep as low-confidence threat signal pending corroboration.

signals.title: Third-party assurance note is incomplete
signals.businessImpact: Executive brief cannot claim reviewed readiness for systems not inspected.
signals.nextAction: Mark evidence pending and avoid overstatement.

signals.title: Executive summaries lack owner and decision owner separation
signals.businessImpact: Escalations stall because action ownership and decision authority are blended.
signals.nextAction: Add separate owner fields in the command center.

signals.title: Support console recovery creates inconsistent customer guidance
signals.businessImpact: Support representatives may give inconsistent recovery instructions.
signals.nextAction: Flag as communications and support enablement issue.

signals.title: Evidence review status is not visible in triage meetings
signals.businessImpact: Unreviewed evidence may be presented as settled fact.
signals.nextAction: Show reviewed, unreviewed, disputed, and pending evidence states in the app.
